#readme

Plates have in plate_id all info:
* antibiotic: for retron expression. Gent + Spec (high copy, pir116) or Tet + Spec (low copy, wt rcaT). Genta was tested at 10 or 5 mg/ml
* IPTG: this is for blocker induction. 0.1 or 1 M.


Images were either left raw or contrast was enhanced for Iris to pick colonies (gray scale correction) --> check both.

```{r}

  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::rename(row.96 = x96_row,
```

#4) annotate with map


```{r}
to_annot_dir = paste0(outputdir,"iris_raw/")

annotate_list_ofplates = function (to_annot_dir, map_touse) {

  setwd(to_annot_dir)
  list_reads <- list.files(to_annot_dir)
  names(list_reads) <- file_path_sans_ext(list_reads)
  #read them
  plates <- lapply(list_reads, read.table, header=T, sep="\t")
  names(plates) <- file_path_sans_ext(list_reads)
  #match reads with the map
  annotated <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(plates)) {
  df <- as.data.frame (plates[[i]])
  annotated [[i]] <- inner_join(df, map_touse, by=c("row","column"))
  }
  names(annotated) <- names(plates)
  
  return(annotated)
  rm(plates)
  rm(list_reads)
}

iris_anno = annotate_list_ofplates(to_annot_dir, goodmap)

for (i in seq_along(iris_anno)) {
  filename = paste0(outputdir, "iris_annotated/", names(iris_anno)[i], ".txt")
  write.table(iris_anno[[i]], filename, sep = "\t", quote=F, row.names = F)
}

setwd(paste0(outputdir, "iris_annotated/"))
list_reads <- list.files(paste0(outputdir,"iris_annotated/"))
names(list_reads) <- file_path_sans_ext(list_reads)

#read them
iris_anno <- lapply(list_reads, read.table, header=T, sep="\t")
names(iris_anno) <- file_path_sans_ext(list_reads)
```

## a) first calculate norm opacity per plate

```{r}
df = df %>%
  mutate(meanop = ave(opacity.corrected, plate_id, strain,FUN= mean))

#norm by gfp per plate
normgfp <- function (df) {
  
  meangfp <- dplyr::filter (df,  genename == "gfp") %>% dplyr::group_by (plate_id) %>%
    dplyr::reframe(meangfp = mean(meanop))
  
  test <- inner_join (df, meangfp, by = "plate_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(normop = opacity.corrected / meangfp)
  
  return(test)
}

df <- normgfp(df)

df = df %>%
  mutate(copynum_ind = sapply(strsplit(as.character(plate_id), "-"),'[',1),
         concentrations = sapply(strsplit(as.character(plate_id), "-"),'[',2),
         condition = sapply(strsplit(as.character(plate_id), "-"),'[',3)) %>%
  mutate(replicate_rcat = sapply(strsplit(as.character(plate_id), "_"),'[',2),
        condition = sapply(strsplit(as.character(condition), "_"),'[',1))


df = df %>%
  mutate(copynum = case_when(condition %in% c(1,2) ~ "p-RcaT",
                               TRUE ~ "pir116"),
         condition_replicate_rcat = interaction(condition, replicate_rcat, sep = "_"),
         rcat_biol_rep = case_when(condition_replicate_rcat %in% c("1_1", "1_2", "2_1", "2_2",  "3_1", "3_2", "4_1", "4_2") ~ 1,
                                 TRUE ~ 2),
         rcat_tech_rep = case_when(condition_replicate_rcat %in% c("1_1", "1_3", "2_1", "2_3",  "3_1", "3_3", "4_1", "4_3") ~ 1,
                                   TRUE ~ 2),
         retron = case_when(condition %in% c(1,3) ~ "Sen2",
                            condition %in% c(2,4) ~ "Eco9"))

df =df %>%
  mutate(antibiotic = ifelse(grepl("Gent", copynum_ind), "Gent", 
                             ifelse(grepl("tet", copynum_ind), "tet", NA)))

remove_patterns <- function(text, pattern1, pattern2) {
  result <- ifelse(text == pattern1 | text == pattern2, "no induction", gsub(paste0(pattern1, "|", pattern2), "", text))
  return(result)
}

df =df %>%
  mutate(induction = remove_patterns(copynum_ind, pattern1="Gent", pattern2="tet"))



df = df %>%
  mutate(IPTGconc = case_when(concentrations %in% c("10050201", "100501", "100100201","1001001") ~ "0.1mM",
                              concentrations %in% c("1005021", "10051", "10010021","100101") ~ "1mM",
                              TRUE ~ "0mM"),
         induction = interaction(induction, IPTGconc, sep = "_"))


```

```{r}
# effect size calculation
test = df %>%
  filter(normop > 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(normop, genename, strain, replicate, rcat_biol_rep, rcat_tech_rep, induction, plate_id, copynum, retron) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(strain,genename, replicate, rcat_biol_rep, rcat_tech_rep, copynum, retron), names_from = induction, values_from = normop) %>%
  mutate(efsize_low = case_when(IPTG_0.1mM != 0 ~ AraIPTG_0.1mM - (IPTG_0.1mM * Ara_0mM),
                                TRUE ~ AraIPTG_0.1mM),
         efsize_high = case_when(IPTG_1mM != 0 ~ AraIPTG_1mM - (IPTG_1mM * Ara_0mM),
                                TRUE ~ AraIPTG_1mM))
  # mutate(efsize_low = case_when(IPTG_0.1mM != 0 ~ AraIPTG_0.1mM/IPTG_0.1mM,
  #                               TRUE ~ AraIPTG_0.1mM),
  #        efsize_high = case_when(IPTG_1mM != 0 ~ AraIPTG_1mM/IPTG_1mM,
  #                               TRUE ~ AraIPTG_1mM))



is.nan.data.frame <- function(x)
do.call(cbind, lapply(x, is.nan))
test[is.nan(test)] <- 0

# to get significance do an anova instead

signif = df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(blocker_expr = case_when(induction %in% c("IPTG_0.1mM","AraIPTG_0.1mM","AraIPTG_1mM","IPTG_1mM") ~ "yes",
                                         TRUE ~ "no"),
                retron_expr = case_when(induction %in% c("AraIPTG_0.1mM", "AraIPTG_1mM", "Ara_0mM") ~ "yes",
                                        TRUE ~ "no"),
                highorlowblockerexpr = case_when(induction %in% c("IPTG_0.1mM","AraIPTG_0.1mM") ~ "low",
                                                 induction %in% c("IPTG_1mM","AraIPTG_1mM") ~ "high",
                                                 TRUE ~ "no induction"))

high_aov = signif %>%
  filter(highorlowblockerexpr %in% c("high", "no induction")) %>%
  dplyr::select(normop, genename,blocker_expr, retron_expr, retron, copynum) %>%
  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,pv_high=anova(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))$"Pr(>F)"[3]) %>%
  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,efsize_high_lm=summary(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))[[4]][[4]]) %>%
  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,pv_high_lm=summary(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))[[4]][[16]]) %>%
  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,se_high_lm=summary(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))[[4]][[8]]) %>%
  distinct(genename,retron,copynum,pv_high, pv_high_lm, efsize_high_lm, se_high_lm)


low_aov = signif %>%

  dplyr::select(normop, genename,blocker_expr, retron_expr, retron, copynum) %>%
  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,pv_low=anova(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))$"Pr(>F)"[3]) %>%
  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,efsize_low_lm=summary(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))[[4]][[4]]) %>%

  plyr::ddply(.(genename,retron,copynum), transform,se_low_lm=summary(lm(normop ~ blocker_expr * retron_expr))[[4]][[8]]) %>%
  distinct(genename,retron,copynum, pv_low, pv_low_lm, efsize_low_lm, se_low_lm)


library("plotrix")
```

# plot error plot for efsize calculated as in Bliss, pvalue from anova over linear model

IMPORTANT: eco9 wt-rcat doesn't work because Ara plates are missing (for grayscale correction version - plates 2_2 and 2_3 SpecTet Ara) 

```{r}
processandplot <- function(x, plasmid, retron_id) {
  
x = x %>%
  filter(copynum == plasmid & retron == retron_id)

pdf(paste0(plotdir,"efsize_", plasmid, "_", retron_id, ".pdf"), width = 9, height = 22)

p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = reorder(genename,meanefsize_high), y = meanefsize_high, colour = as.factor(hit_high))) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=meanefsize_high - se_efsize_high, ymax = meanefsize_high + se_efsize_high)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  labs(y="mean((blocker+toxin) - blocker*toxin) ± sd (Bliss)", x="gene", colour = "", title = "High blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

p1 <- ggplot(x, aes(x = reorder(genename,meanefsize_low), y = meanefsize_low, colour = as.factor(hit_low))) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=meanefsize_low - se_efsize_low, ymax = meanefsize_low + se_efsize_low)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  labs(y="mean((blocker+toxin) - blocker*toxin) ± sd (Bliss)", x="gene", colour = "", title = "Low blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggplot(x, aes(x = reorder(genename,efsize_high_lm), y = efsize_high_lm, colour = as.factor(hit_high))) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=efsize_high_lm - se_high_lm, ymax = efsize_high_lm + se_high_lm)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  labs(y="lm(fitness ~ blocker * retron)", x="gene", colour = "", title = "High blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

p3 <- ggplot(x, aes(x = reorder(genename,efsize_low_lm), y = efsize_low_lm, colour = as.factor(hit_low))) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=efsize_low_lm - se_low_lm, ymax = efsize_low_lm + se_low_lm)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  labs(y="lm(fitness ~ blocker * retron)", x="gene", colour = "", title = "Low blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()


print(p)

print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)

dev.off()

}


processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "p-RcaT", retron_id = "Sen2")
processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "p-RcaT", retron_id = "Eco9")
processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "pir116", retron_id = "Sen2")
processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "pir116", retron_id = "Eco9")
```

```{r}

processandplot <- function(x, plasmid, retron_id) {
  
x = x %>%
  filter(copynum == plasmid & retron == retron_id)

pdf(paste0(plotdir,"volcano_", plasmid, "_", retron_id, ".pdf"), width = 7.8, height = 6)

p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = efsize_high_lm, y = -log10(pv_high_lm), colour = as.factor(hit_high))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=-log10(0.01)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genename), max.overlaps = 50, size = 2,
                            data = x %>%
                             filter(hit_high == "hit") %>%
                              dplyr::select(genename, efsize_high_lm, pv_high_lm, hit_high) %>% distinct()) +
  labs(x="lm(fitness ~ blocker * retron)", y="-log10(pval)", colour = "", title = "High blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

p1 <- ggplot(x, aes(x = efsize_low_lm, y = -log10(pv_low_lm), colour = as.factor(hit_low))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=-log10(0.01)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genename), max.overlaps = 50, size = 2,
                            data = x %>%
                             filter(hit_low == "hit") %>%
                              dplyr::select(genename, efsize_low_lm, pv_low_lm, hit_low) %>% distinct()) +
  labs(x="lm(fitness ~ blocker * retron)", y="-log10(pval)", colour = "", title = "Low blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggplot(x, aes(x = meanefsize_high, y = -log10(pv_high_lm), colour = as.factor(hit_high))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=-log10(0.01)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genename), max.overlaps = 50, size = 2,
                            data = x %>%
                             filter(hit_high == "hit") %>%
                              dplyr::select(genename, meanefsize_high, pv_high_lm, hit_high) %>% distinct()) +
  labs(x="mean(blocker+retron - blocker*retron) (Bliss)", y="-log10(pval)", colour = "", title = "High blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

p3 <- ggplot(x, aes(x = meanefsize_low, y = -log10(pv_low_lm), colour = as.factor(hit_low))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept=-log10(0.01)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","grey")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genename), max.overlaps = 50, size = 2,
                            data = x %>%
                             filter(hit_low == "hit") %>%
                              dplyr::select(genename, meanefsize_low, pv_low_lm, hit_low) %>% distinct()) +
  labs(x="mean(blocker+retron - blocker*retron) (Bliss)", y="-log10(pval)", colour = "", title = "Low blocker induction") +
  theme_bw()

print(p)

print(p1)

print(p2)

print(p3)

dev.off()

}
```

### plot correlation bliss lm for each retron/copy number with densities

```{r}

processandplot <- function(x, plasmid, retron_id) {
  
x = x %>%
  filter(copynum == plasmid & retron == retron_id)

pmain <- ggscatter(x %>%
            distinct(hit, meanefsize_high, efsize_high_lm, retron,genename, copynum), x="meanefsize_high", y = "efsize_high_lm", color = "hit",alpha=0.5, rug=TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1) +
  #facet_wrap(~ copynum) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("red","blue","lightblue","grey")) +
  stat_cor(label.y.npc="bottom", label.x.npc = "center", method = "pearson") +
  border() +
  # ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genename), max.overlaps = 50, size = 2,
  #                           data = final %>%
  #                            distinct(hit, meanefsize_high, efsize_high_lm,retron, genename, copynum) %>%
  #                            filter(hit == "neutral in both" & meanefsize_high > 0.1)) +
  labs(x="Bliss score (high blocker induction)",y = "lm effect size (high blocker induction)", color = "hit according to lm")

# Marginal densities along x axis
xdens <- axis_canvas(pmain, axis = "x")+
  geom_density(data = x %>%
            distinct(hit, meanefsize_high, efsize_high_lm, retron,genename, copynum), aes(x = meanefsize_high),
              alpha = 0.7, size = 0.2)
# Marginal densities along y axis
# Need to set coord_flip = TRUE, if you plan to use coord_flip()
ydens <- axis_canvas(pmain, axis = "y", coord_flip = TRUE)+
  geom_density(data = x %>%
            distinct(hit, meanefsize_high, efsize_high_lm, retron,genename, copynum), aes(x = efsize_high_lm),
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.2)+
  coord_flip()
p1 <- insert_xaxis_grob(pmain, xdens, grid::unit(.2, "null"), position = "top")
p2<- insert_yaxis_grob(p1, ydens, grid::unit(.2, "null"), position = "right")
fig <- ggdraw(p2)
ggsave(paste0(plotdir,"concord_Bliss_lm_density_nolabels", plasmid, "_", retron_id, ".pdf"),fig, width = 6, height = 6)

}


processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "p-RcaT", retron_id = "Eco9")
processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "p-RcaT", retron_id = "Sen2")
processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "pir116", retron_id = "Eco9")
processandplot(x = final, plasmid = "pir116", retron_id = "Sen2")
```
